evidence.activity: Geek Squad Academy employee volunteer program teaching technology to young learners

evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Training and Development

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size

evidence.activity: Best Buy Altitude career growth program for leaders
evidence.quote: We continued to invest in career growth and development for our employees through the Best Buy Altitude program, allowing leaders to develop their leadership skills and prepare for their next role, creating a talent bench behind high impact roles.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Training and Development

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size

evidence.activity: Joshin caregiver support benefit focused on disabilities and neurodivergence for employees and their families
evidence.quote: Access to Joshin, a support system for employees and their loved ones with a focus on disabilities and neurodivergence;
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Employee Benefits

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific inclusive benefit for people with disabilities, no reach figures

evidence.activity: Best Buy Marketplace earns commissions from third-party marketplace sales
evidence.quote: Services - advertising, delivery, health-related services, installation, marketplace commissions, memberships, repair, set-up, technical support, warranty-related services

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: seller marketplace appears only as a brand name and revenue line; the filing does not describe its sellers as founders or small businesses

creativity.reason: Level 1: the only creative activity is in-house design of exclusive-brand products (a routine input); reselling gaming software and imaging gear is not described as creating or enabling creative work.

community.reason: Level 2: specific current external education programs (Teen Tech Center, Geek Squad Academy) with no participant or dollar figures, plus employee development; torn between 2 and 3, so the lower level was chosen.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: one specific current inclusive benefit for employees' families with disabilities and neurodivergence, with no reach figures; the rest of the Inclusion and Belonging section is general language.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: Best Buy Marketplace and Best Buy Business are named, but the filing describes no service aimed at founders or small-business barriers; torn between 1 and 2, so the lower level was chosen.

ai.notes: The targeted Item 7 excerpt was empty, so all evidence comes from Item 1. The Social Impact section says the company is 'refreshing our community commitments' toward youth economic opportunity; only the currently operating programs (Teen Tech Center, Geek Squad Academy) were scored. The Teen Tech Center runs through the Best Buy Foundation, with Best Buy as fiscal sponsor. The HOPE Fund (up to $2,500 hardship aid, in partnership with the Richard M. Schulze Family Foundation) is an employee benefit, not community investment, so it was not scored. Inclusion and Belonging language is general apart from the Joshin benefit. The filing refers to the Fiscal 2026 CR&S Report (not yet published) for more human capital detail, but it gives specific activities itself, so coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. The E3 quote ends before the sentence's final purpose clause ('to ensure young people are prepared for the demands of today's economy') to stay near the length limit; the meaning is unchanged.
